Rakesh was extremely professional, calm, and made me feel very comfortable throughout the process. The studio is very clean and hygienic, and the piercing was quick, almost painless, and perfectly placed. He also explained the aftercare clearly. Highly recommend Rakesh at Haveli Studio for a safe and smooth piercing experience! ✨

featured_reviews.name: Sayali Chavan
featured_reviews.review_text:
I currently live in Ireland and was visiting Mumbai for just one month. During that time, I wanted to get a tattoo that truly matched the design I had in my mind. I spoke to several artists, but no one was able to understand or match my idea the way I wanted.

Then I connected with Sanjay from Haveli Tattoo. He was extremely patient with all my ideas and thoughts and assured me that he would keep working on the design until it was exactly what I wanted. What impressed me the most was his dedication — he was literally boarding a flight for his vacation and was still available on WhatsApp discussing and refining my tattoo design with me. That level of professionalism is rare.

The final result was amazing. The shading, fine detailing, and clean lines were absolutely perfect. I got the perfect minimal fine needle tattoo I was looking for! The astronaut tattoo was a customized concept that meant a lot to me, and Sanjay turned that idea into reality beautifully!

This tattoo was a birthday gift to myself, and I couldn’t be any more happier with the result. I’ve definitely found my tattoo artist for life now. Highly recommended!

featured_reviews.name: Siddhit Sanghavi
featured_reviews.review_text: We went to Haveli Tattoo Studio first for a piercing my 6 yo daughter’s ear. The artist was patient and helpful, making sure my daughter stayed comfortable. We liked the environment and decided to get a tattoo for myself and my wife symbolizing our three daughters. I had a clear vision and wanted an understanding of how it would be realised as a tattoo and Sanjay did that by refining our design, warning us of things to keep in mind with style, shading and size and had a careful setup process to ensure the permanent tattoo followed our expectations. In this instance too he made us comfortable as it was our first time and it has turned out just like I imagined it. The place is clean and has good vibes with a TV to help you distract yourself. His sister was also there being an excellent TV DJ :-). Lastly, please order his special cold brew coffee was delicious and a unique recipe, try it out even if you are not there for a tattoo! Highly recommend Sanjay and his team at Haveli Tattoo Studio

featured_reviews.review_text:
I walked into the studio with a plan of 2 piercings and 1 tattoo. Now plot twist - the energy and the vibe of the place was so powerful and fun - that while planning and designing my tattoo - I made an impromptu decision of another tattoo as well. BEST DECISION EVER.

Sanjay was so full of patience and love towards the whole process. People say tattoos are painful but here, with Sanjay - they're fun and relaxing! His hand was so light during the entire process. I had FUN! Definitely my go to tattoo artist hereafter!

Now coming to the piercings - I got a helix and tragus piercing. Rakesh explained the whole thing so beautifully. Showed me everything, helped me select the stud. And he was so perfect and quick at the thing that in no time - before I could even feel the pain, they were done!

Thoroughly enjoyed my time there at the studio - both my tattoos and my piercings!

Oh and, they also have a crazy coffee menu - I had the cranberry one and omg I fell in love! Must try!

So all in all - both the experiences were made memorable and with full of love!

Highly highly recommend this place! ♥️

featured_reviews.review_text:

My artist took the time to understand exactly what I wanted, made a few creative suggestions, and absolutely nailed the final design. The attention to detail and precision was impressive — you can tell they take real pride in their work.

featured_reviews.name: Manohar Nair
featured_reviews.review_text:
Some people tattoo designs.

He tattoos stories.

Coming from a Fine Arts background, his foundation as an artist is evident in every stroke of his work. What truly sets him apart is his extraordinary eye for detail and his ability to transform emotions, memories, and meanings into a single piece of art.

Watching him work feels like watching magic. His fingers move with the confidence and precision of a master craftsman, bringing life to an idea that exists only in your mind.

What he created on my chest is not just a tatto..it's an entire story. A story of love, emotion, symbolism, and meaning, all captured within a single image. Anyone can draw. Very few can communicate an entire narrative without using a single word.

That requires a rare gift.

The level of thought, artistry, detail, and execution in his work is exceptional. He doesn't simply ink skin; he creates timeless pieces that speak for themselves.

If you are looking for a tattoo artist, you will find many. If you are looking for a true artist who can turn a deeply personal story into a masterpiece, you will find very few.

I was fortunate enough to find one of them.

SUMIT is truly the best.
